[2] Donovan R. Cook III is an American film director, best known for creating, directing and producing the animated series "2 Stupid Dogs" and directing the Disney animated features "Return to Never Land" and "".
[3] He played for the undefeated 1894 Yale Bulldogs football team and was selected as the consensus first-team center on the 1894 College Football All-America Team.
